+---
+## What
+
+`cli-plan.md` §5 and §8. The binary needs one place that owns every byte that
+is not the answer text. The rule is absolute: this layer writes to **stderr**
+only, and it draws nothing when stderr is not a terminal.
+
+The family takes Noora directly, with no spike: the agent package's C1 spike is
+cancelled by that decision, and `FoundationModelsACPAgent/cli-plan.md` §5.2 and
+its milestone C1 need an update to say so. Raise that as a note in the pull
+request; do not edit the sibling repository from this task.
+
+Create `Sources/acp-client/TerminalOutput.swift`:
+
+- `enum TerminalVerbosity: Sendable { case quiet, normal, verbose }`, resolved
+  from `--quiet` and `--verbose`. `--quiet` wins over `--verbose`.
+- `struct TerminalOutput: Sendable`, built with the verbosity and an injected
+  `isStandardErrorATerminal: @Sendable () -> Bool`, plus an injected sink
+  `@Sendable (String) -> Void` that production points at stderr and a test
+  points at a buffer. Nothing in this type touches stdout.
+- `func event(_ line: String)` writes one line, only at `.verbose`.
+- `func error(_ line: String)` writes one line at every verbosity, `.quiet`
+  included: §8 says `--quiet` writes nothing but errors.
+- `func withSpinner<T>(_ label: String, _ body: () async throws -> T) async
+  rethrows -> T`. It runs a Noora spinner on stderr while `body` runs, and it
+  runs `body` with no drawing at all when stderr is not a terminal or the
+  verbosity is `.quiet`. The label carries no claim about what the agent is
+  doing: a foreign agent may be downloading a model, and we cannot know (§8).
+- `func toolCallLine(_ name: String)` rewrites one line in place with the
+  running tool name, and does nothing off a terminal.
+
+Add an `ACPLogger` bridge, so `SwiftUIACPClient.connect(over:logger:)` routes
+its diagnostics into `event(_:)` and never into stdout.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] Every write this type makes goes to stderr. A grep of
+      `Sources/acp-client/TerminalOutput.swift` finds no `standardOutput`,
+      no `print(` and no `FileHandle.standardOutput`.
+- [ ] With `isStandardErrorATerminal` false, `withSpinner` and `toolCallLine`
+      emit zero bytes, and `body` still runs and returns its value.
+- [ ] At `.quiet`, `event(_:)` emits zero bytes in a terminal too, and
+      `error(_:)` still emits.
+- [ ] At `.normal`, `event(_:)` emits zero bytes; only `--verbose` turns the
+      session events on.
+- [ ] `--quiet` together with `--verbose` resolves to `.quiet`.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] New `Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientTests/TerminalOutputTests.swift`.
+      Each test builds `TerminalOutput` over a buffer sink and a chosen
+      `isStandardErrorATerminal` value, then asserts the exact bytes the buffer
+      holds. One test per acceptance row above.
+- [ ] One test asserts `withSpinner` returns the body's value and rethrows the
+      body's error, under both terminal states.
+- [ ] One test reads `Sources/acp-client/TerminalOutput.swift` through
+      `RepositoryFile.read(relativePath:)` and asserts it names no stdout
+      handle, so the stdout rule cannot rot.
+- [ ] Run `swift test`. Every assertion passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
